title: Why Privacy Matters
summary: Why “nothing to hide” is the wrong question, a live Lightning privacy test, and every link shared on the call.
share_text: Why privacy matters: notes + every resource from the @CodeOrangeDevs Sovereign Bitcoiner Workshop
tldr: “Nothing to hide” is the wrong question. Privacy is about power.
Bitcoin is public on purpose. Privacy is added in layers on top.
Custodial wallets can hand your payment history to anyone who asks.
Pick your defences with a simple threat model, not fear.
